description: Search agent memory semantically using natural language queries. Supports cross-session search and filtering by tags, user, or time range.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

min_importance.description: Minimum importance score (0.0 to 1.0) to filter results

query.description: Natural language query to search for in memory (e.g., "user preferences about food")

scope.description: Search scope: session (current conversation), agent (all sessions for this agent), or global

session_id.description: Optional session ID to limit search to specific conversation

user_id.description: Optional user ID to search across all sessions for this user

name: zerodb_search_memory
